sql: WITH t AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||':'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS contest, (pnl/quantity)*100 AS c, CASE WHEN coalesce(side,'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END AS entry FROM paper_trades WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['settled','closed_sl']) AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%%mmsell%%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins)), k AS (SELECT series, contest, sum(c) AS cp, avg(entry) AS ce FROM t GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT series, count(*) AS contests, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cp<0) AS losses, round(avg(ce)::numeric,1) AS entry, round(avg(cp) FILTER (WHERE cp>0)::numeric,2) AS awin, round(avg(cp) FILTER (WHERE cp<0)::numeric,2) AS aloss FROM k GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
